sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast. This episode is for upper intermediate and advanced English listeners. 2025 is coming to an end. So soon this year went by so fast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。本集適合中高級和高級英語聽眾。 2025年即將結束。時間這麼快，這一年過得這麼快。

sentences.en: I am most proud of from this year was deciding to create my Tik Tok channel. Making the decision to record myself one day and speak slowly.
sentences.tc: 今年我最自豪的是決定創建我的 Tik Tok 頻道。決定有一天為自己錄音並慢慢地說。

sentences.en: Then create my YouTube channel shortly after onto creating an English community with people from all around the world learning English. This year has been crazy. So many ups and downs,.
sentences.tc: 不久之後，我創建了我的 YouTube 頻道，並創建了一個英語社區，讓來自世界各地的人們學習英語。今年很瘋狂。這麼多的坎坷，。

sentences.en: Learning from both the achievements and the failures, finding the beauty in every moment because that's.
sentences.tc: 從成就和失敗中學習，發現每時每刻的美麗，因為那就是。

sentences.en: What life is. It can't all be good, but that's what makes those good moments so special. That's?
sentences.tc: 生活是什麼。一切不可能都是美好的，但這正是那些美好時刻如此特別的原因。那是？

sentences.en: What keeps us positive and grateful. Knowing that even in the worst moments, there will always be better moments. Tell me,?
sentences.tc: 是什麼讓我們保持正面和感恩。知道即使在最糟糕的時刻，總會有更好的時刻。告訴我，？

sentences.en: What are you the most grateful for from this year?
sentences.tc: 今年以來，你最感恩的事是什麼？

sentences.en: What is the best thing you achieved this year personally, professionally, spiritually, mentally, physically, or anything that made?
sentences.tc: 今年您在個人、職業、精神、心理、身體或其他方面所取得的最佳成就是什麼？

sentences.en: You could be an achievement for someone else. For instance, if I was doing a presentation in front of a group of people.
sentences.tc: 你可能會成為別人的成就。例如，如果我在一群人面前做演示。

sentences.en: I stuttered a lot and I was nervous and maybe I forgot a few topics.
sentences.tc: 我經常結巴，而且很緊張，也許我忘記了一些話題。

sentences.en: I was going to talk about, but to me that's still a huge success. It's a huge achievement.
sentences.tc: 我本來想談論的，但對我來說這仍然是一個巨大的成功。這是一項巨大的成就。

sentences.en: I was able to speak in public and I never thought I would get over my fear of public speaking. Now for someone else, the presentation went wrong.
sentences.tc: 我能夠在公開場合演講，但我從未想過我會克服對公開演講的恐懼。現在對於其他人來說，演示出了問題。

sentences.en: They messed up and stuttered.
sentences.tc: 他們語無倫次，結結巴巴。

sentences.en: They might consider it a failure. But now let's think who is going to be able to see the positives, the bright side to everything that happens to them. Well,.
sentences.tc: 他們可能會認為這是一次失敗。但現在讓我們想想誰能夠看到發生在他們身上的一切積極的一面。出色地，。

sentences.en: I am because I can see it as an achievement, not a failure. I think it's important to notice your small achievements. Give yourself credit.
sentences.tc: 我之所以這麼做是因為我認為這是一項成就，而不是失敗。我認為注意到你的小成就很重要。給自己一點信心。

sentences.en: If you look for something, you'll find it. So, look for small achievements throughout the day. Give yourself credit for all those little things that go unnoticed. Notice them. Don't let them.
sentences.tc: 如果你尋找某樣東西，你就會找到它。因此，全天尋找小成就。為所有那些被忽視的小事給予自己信任。注意他們。別讓他們。

sentences.en: I do that? Regrets. Let me say I hate regretting. Ever since.
sentences.tc: 我這樣做？遺憾。讓我說我討厭後悔。從此以後。

sentences.en: I was a little girl, I have always hated regretting. I have always said.
sentences.tc: 我還是個小女孩，我一直討厭後悔。我一直都這麼說。

sentences.en: I don't regret anything because everything absolutely everything happens for a reason. Everything that you've done wrong, right, even the worst of decisions, the worst of situations made.
sentences.tc: 我不後悔任何事情，因為一切絕對都是有原因的。你所做的一切都是錯的，對的，甚至是最糟糕的決定，最糟糕的情況。

sentences.en: You the person that you are today. And you wouldn't be the person.
sentences.tc: 你就是今天的你。而你不會是那個人。

sentences.en: You are if it wasn't for those mistakes, no matter what it is.
sentences.tc: 如果不是因為那些錯誤，無論是什麼錯誤，你都是這樣的。

sentences.en: When I was younger and I would get in trouble with my parents or my teachers,?
sentences.tc: 當我年輕的時候，我會和我的父母或老師發生麻煩嗎？

sentences.en: I would never regret it, but I would learn from it. Just like right now,.
sentences.tc: 我永遠不會後悔，但我會從中學到教訓。就像現在一樣，。

sentences.en: I had to do this to be the person.
sentences.tc: 我必須這樣做才能成為那個人。
